description: A digital concept art illustration of a hulking dwarf brute warrior, imposing and dangerous.

character_details.build: Short, stocky, and heavily muscled with a broad, barrel-shaped torso and thick limbs.
character_details.pose: The figure stands in a wide, grounded combat stance, both hands gripping a massive warhammer planted head-down in front of them, shoulders squared toward the viewer.
character_details.headgear: A deep red hooded cowl that completely obscures the face, adorned with a golden vertical line and crescent emblem, stretched taut over a thick, broad skull.

armor.shoulder: An oversized, ornate golden pauldron on the left shoulder featuring a stylized, snarling dwarven face (mask-like).
armor.torso: Heavy dark brown brigandine with oversized metal rivets and reinforced plate segments over a chainmail underlayer.
armor.arms: Thick metallic gauntlets with gold trim and spiked knuckle guards.
armor.waist: Wide leather belts with several oversized utility pouches and a heavy chain hanging from the hip.

character_details.clothing: A tattered red cape or cloak draped over the right shoulder, shorter and more ragged to accommodate the stocky frame.

weaponry.warhammer: A massive two-handed warhammer with a golden-wrapped haft, ornate dwarven runes along the head, and a reinforced striking face.

artistic_style.lighting: Studio-style lighting with soft shadows and sharp metallic highlights
